title: neottia autumnalis
intro: Neottia autumnalis, commonly known as Autumn Lady's Tresses, is a type of orchid native to North America. This perennial plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Neottia autumnalis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
